newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's AAPT acquires Melbourne operation.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's AAPT acquires Melbourne operation.

text.p: AAP Telecommunications Pty Ltd AAPT, the third largest carrier in Australia, said on Monday it had acquired the long distance customer base of Melbourne based switchless reseller Access Plus.
Access Plus, which had about 3,000 high spend residential and business customers, had its own billing platform and used both the Telstra and Optus networks, AAPT said in a statement.

AAPT director Steve Picton said the acquisition would enable AAPT to offer improved levels of service, increased levels of discounts, and additional services including mobile, enhanced fax, and Internet.
"We intend to be well positioned for carrier status in the deregulated environment next year," he said.
Both companies would actively explore other sales and product opportunities, he said.

AAPT is jointly owned by AAP Communications Holdings Pty Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of AAP Information Services Pty Ltd (51 percent), STI Holding Pte, a wholly owned subsidiary of Singapore Telecom International (24.5 percent) and New Zealand-owned Todd Corp (Australia) Ltd (24.5 percent).
